expectations.text: It preserves backup, destination confirmation and irreversible Apply warning near the action.
expectations.evidence: Step 1 requires a backup, and step 4 combines destination workspace confirmation with the warning that applying cannot be undone.

expectations.text: It preserves missing past transactions AND the distinct lot-label and expiry-date loss for opening quantities.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly distinguishes opening quantities from past transactions and separately names source lot labels and expiry dates as not retained.

expectations.text: It preserves that later receipts cannot retroactively identify opening units and says to keep source records for recalls/expiry tracking.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly says later receipts do not retroactively identify opening units and source records must be kept for recalls and expiry tracking.

expectations.text: It uses the current Comment-column support rather than retaining the obsolete comments restriction and keeps the supported CSV preview/apply path.
expectations.evidence: Imports comments through the Comment column and preserves Import > CSV, item/quantity preview, then Apply.
